name: Tarnell
summary: A menswear tailoring store whose home plays like a film, with a gold thread woven through its name
about: A complete online store for a tailoring house. The home page is a scroll-driven film: a gold thread stitches in front of and behind the TARNELL wordmark, cloth unrolls and is cut along a chalk line, a seam runs, and a jacket assembles on the stand. Below it are the house story, the season's pieces and three showrooms with live open or closed status. The shop has filters, sort, cloth and size pickers, a PKR bag with promo codes, a validated checkout and a fitting booking page with days, time slots and a wax-seal confirmation.
how: Scroll the home page to play the four scenes; the rail on the right shows progress and Skip film jumps past it.
Open the collection and filter by department, colour, size, price or reduced pieces, then sort or search.
On a piece, choose a cloth colour (the picture redraws like a drape), a size and a quantity, then Add to bag: a garment box flies to the bag.
In the bag, change quantities, remove pieces and try the house codes TAILOR10 or COURIERFREE.
Checkout validates your details and runs a pressing, folding and courier sequence before a wax seal stamps the thank-you page.
On Fittings, pick a showroom, a day (Sundays are closed) and a free time slot, add your name and mobile, then reserve the hour for a booking reference.
